name: s1-lint-toolerror
final_text:
I asked the operator via `ask_human`. What came back:

- **First call was rejected.** The tool returned a voice-rules error: remove the em-dashes (2 found) and expand the contraction `can't`.
- **Second call was accepted.** I rewrote the prompt using colons instead of em-dashes and "cannot" instead of "can't", keeping both options and both consequences. The tool returned: `ACCEPTED. The human reads it now.`

Note that the tool has not returned an actual answer — only confirmation that the prompt passed the voice check and is now in front of the operator. I do not have a choice of 3 or 5 to report yet.
